headline: On November 11, 2002: Perelman posts proof of Poincaré conjecture
captionCards: Only Millennium Prize Problem solved to date
Refused $1M prize and Fields Medal for his work
instagramCaption:
Grigori Perelman solved the Poincaré conjecture.

He posted the first of three preprint texts in 2002, proving a century-old math mystery. The only Millennium Prize Problem ever solved, it stunned the world. He later refused both the $1 million prize and the Fields Medal. His work reshaped geometric topology.

Why does this still matter? It’s the only Millennium Prize Problem resolved—proof that deep insight can emerge from quiet brilliance.

What would you sacrifice for truth in science?
